title: HTTPS function calls
summary: Side-effect-free handlers share a 25-second read budget inside the 30-second HTTPS attempt, and retry once inside it when their database connection drops. Expiry returns read_deadline_exceeded with a narrower-read recovery and Performance failure evidence. The deploy driver re-reads its read-only execution calls after read_deadline_exceeded on a short bounded backoff, and an exhausted read ends as a stage failure naming the rerun recovery, not a usage error. A response timeout is reported once and never resent, because the server may still be running the call, and its relay telemetry records the application outcome as unknown rather than not reached; only failures that never reached the server retry. The one exception is deployment-run creation: it waits 60 seconds, under the hosted path's 70-second cap, and the CLI repeats a timed-out create once under its idempotency key and reports the run it recovered. A second connection drop, or a drop in a state-changing function, returns control_plane_connection_lost with a re-read-then-rerun recovery; a deployment run row still locked after its 2-second bound answers run_busy naming the holder and its age, a lock timeout answers lock_timeout and a cancelled statement answers statement_cancelled, all of which callers retry; any other handler exception answers handler_exception on in-process and HTTPS dispatch alike, and the server log records its traceback frame locations without the message or payload.
note: Agent blocker evaluation, complete reflection capture and merge-audit facts use registered transport. Claude role telemetry shares hook evaluation across all role grants. Source audit distinguishes server/admin/local-only ownership in docs/source-dev/control-plane-client-routes.md; installed candidate proof remains separate. Deployed CLI probes compare HTTPS server origins while retaining the organization API path; comparing that full path with BASE_URL falsely rejects hosted connections. Origin correction has passing source tests; deployed QA remains pending.
